sections.heading: Writing books
items: Ranked members of the College of Winterhold, the Synod, the College of Whispers, House Telvanni and the Bards College can now write their own books at a Scholars' Ledger: choose "Write a book".

A book has a title and up to 10 pages. Writing one costs 100 gold, a Paper Roll per page, an Inkwell, and Leather for a tome or Linen Wrap for a bound book (a one-page scroll needs no binding). Keep a Quill in your pack: it is not used up.
"Copy a book" at the ledger makes another copy of a book you wrote, or one written by your own college or house, for half the gold and the same materials.
Each character may write 3 new books a week and make 15 copies a week.

sections.heading: Reading and sharing
items: Your books are kept in your library: type /books to see them and /books read <title or number> to read one.
Hand a copy to someone standing near you with /books give <name> <title>.
Put a book on display in your own home with /decor book <title>. Anyone in the home can open it to read it, and your copy stays in your library. A home can display up to 10 books.
Reading a written book gives no skill experience.
